title: Jake Stevens's band and theater orchestras
summary: He played cornet in Jake Stevens's band, better than the leader himself, and mentions Falk and Frank Frobel and theater bands.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you have something else? Sir go ahead. No I don't, I don't know. I think I covered everything that I can think of. Huh? I think I'll ask you everything I can think of. Or uh, well you did say you played with the American brass band but you told me the other day that you played with some other brass bands. Do you remember the names of them?
I did play with others. He was a great friend and I would ask him to hire him to play.
Jake Stevens, did I tell you about him playing?
Nick Stevens? Yeah. No I don't think he did. Well I played with him. You played with him? Yeah. Did he play something too?
Yeah he played corner too. Uh huh.
And he was the leader of the band?
He was the leader. But I was a better corner player than he was. Uh huh. But uh notwithstanding the fact he was a leader. He, that leader business you gotta run around for him. Yeah. You understand?

He got the job, that's the idea. Yeah. He got the job. But uh this fella that I was telling you about Eddie Falken and Klein that that fella was man that was a beautiful finals player. Uh huh. And Frank Frobel, he was another cracker jack. He used to play in theater. Uh huh. Pretty regular. But they don't have that no more in theaters. No.
They used to have bands in all them theaters. Like the Grand Opera and the St. Charles Theater. A different band but they don't have that no more.
